components.name: Primary Wine Pill Button
components.description: Main action trigger across modals and lessons with Quiet Blue hover transition.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #8d1e32; color: #fffaf7; font: 700 13px/1 'Manrope', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(141, 30, 50, 0.24); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #46658b; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #46658b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card-kpi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; width: 220px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255, 251, 248, 0.78); color: #2c1017; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(72, 18, 30, 0.08); font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-card-kpi:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: rgba(255, 252, 250, 0.94); } .ds-kpi-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-kpi-icon { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #fffaf7; color: #681426; } .ds-kpi-trend { padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e3edf6; color: #46658b; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-kpi-val { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi-sub { margin-top: 12px; } .ds-kpi-sub strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #3b141e; } .ds-kpi-sub span { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 10px; color: #7c6369; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Pill
components.description: Floating smoked-wine glass sidebar navigation item with crisp cream active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 220px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(112, 28, 44, 0.82), rgba(58, 15, 25, 0.92)); font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: transparent; color: rgba(255, 244, 246, 0.78); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255, 250, 247, 0.12); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: #fffaf7; color: #681426; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(40, 8, 16, 0.18); } .ds-badge { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #b22a42; color: #fffaf7; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
LingoLy pairs an editorial warm-cream landing experience with a tactile Glassy Dashboard V24 learning workspace. Instead of clinical white cards or cold dark-mode fintech panels, the learning workspace suspends translucent champagne-beige glass boards (rgba(252, 246, 241, 0.88)) and a smoked-wine glass sidebar over an ambient wine-to-sand canvas. Every study session feels like stepping into a sunlit personal studio where daily momentum, vocabulary retention, and lesson schedules are organized into a scannable Bento grid.

Color is purposeful and emotionally grounded in LingoLy's triadic identity: Wine Red (#8d1e32) drives primary actions, hero momentum cards, and streak highlights; Quiet Blue (#46658b) anchors secondary data series, phonetic cues, and positive trend badges; and Warm Beige & Cream (#fffaf7 / #ede0d7) form the frosted glass surfaces that keep reading effortless for Vietnamese learners.
keyCharacteristics: Floating frosted-glass architecture (backdrop-filter: blur(20px–28px)) over a warm multi-stop wine, blush, and sand ambient backdrop.

Bento grid workspace combining a saturated Wine-Red momentum hero card (with a 68% segmented circular gauge and orbiting skill badges), an interactive 7-day calendar & lesson schedule card, and 4 KPI cards with smooth SVG sparklines.
Vietnamese-safe display and editorial typography pairing geometric Manrope with italic Noto Serif accents that keep Vietnamese diacritics crisp at all sizes.
Zero-clutter hierarchy: headings speak directly without eyebrows or kickers above them, and all icons are rendered with consistent 1.85px stroke SVGs.

rules.name: The One Highlighted Bento Rule
rules.body: In any multi-card KPI row, exactly one card (such as the 7-day Streak card) may wear the full Wine-Red gradient (#b32a42 to #681426); its sibling cards remain translucent champagne-beige glass (rgba(255, 251, 248, 0.72)) so the focal metric commands immediate attention.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never use pure achromatic gray (#808080 or #f5f5f5) inside the learning workspace; every surface, muted label, and divider is tinted from the Wine-Beige warm axis (#6f5a60, rgba(141, 30, 50, 0.12)).

rules.name: The Serif Inflection Rule
rules.body: Inside the Bento Hero Card and Landing headlines, highlight the single most emotional phrase using italic Noto Serif (rất đều) with a soft blush underline (text-underline-offset: 5px), never gradient text.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every progress percentage (68%), calendar date (08), duration (09:30), and KPI counter (86, 94.8%) enforces font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so numbers align cleanly across rows and state updates.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Declaration Rule
rules.body: Cards declare their depth through translucent fill plus a soft offset shadow (--shadow-card), never combining a 1px structural border with a wide drop shadow.

dos: Do preserve the triadic Wine Red (#8d1e32) + Quiet Blue (#46658b) + Warm Beige (#ede0d7 / #fffaf7) palette across both the Landing Page and the Glassy Dashboard V24 workspace.
Do use Noto Serif for italic display emphasis and Manrope with tabular-nums for all metrics, percentages, dates, and timers.
Do keep card border radii at 16px (12px–14px for inner rows) and use 999px pills for buttons, day capsules, and status badges.
Do use consistent 1.85px–2px stroke inline SVGs for all icons and sparklines.
donts: Don't place uppercase kickers or eyebrows above headings (<h1>, <h2>, <h3>); let the heading carry its own hierarchy or use an interactive live-status pill where appropriate.
Don't use raw Unicode glyphs or emojis (✦, →, •••) as UI icons inside the learning workspace.
Don't tighten letter-spacing past -0.04em on any heading or display text.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing (cubic-bezier(.2, 1.4, ...)): always decelerate smoothly with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
